work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Substantive fragment of an independently headed Clement XI jubilee brief. The complete printed preamble and beginning of the grant survive; retain own title/variant apparatus38957–61/39010 and original/editorial dates39055–58. What is absent: the grant continuation and substantive conditions after39052–53, where basilicas vel earum aliquam ends in eie. (Reliqua ni alibi), before dates follow. These are substantive omissions, not merely closing formulas. Preserves the surviving OCR witness and its references without supplying absent text; not a complete act and no authenticity claim.
